I have farmed this small plot of 0.18 hectares for many years and I know what works here. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive for such a small piece of land, so I will use compost and manure from my animals instead. These are local trees I have always had, so I do not need new seed, and I will not spend money on pesticides or irrigation. My family will do the work — about 30 days this season — because I cannot pay hired labor.
